about: Starter retrieval set (hand-written, synthetic). Section 7 asks for 200-500 labeled queries; grow this with real queries. Categories: keyword (shares distinctive words), paraphrase (same meaning, few shared words), multi (several relevant items), stale (an outdated item would match), none (nothing relevant exists).

contexts.title: Orders database
contexts.body: Orders are stored in PostgreSQL 16. Every write goes through a transactional outbox table that consumers read from. Never use last-write-wins.

contexts.title: Payments via Stripe Checkout
contexts.body: Use Stripe Checkout hosted pages. Card data never touches our servers, which keeps us out of PCI scope.

contexts.title: Store money as integer cents
contexts.body: Monetary amounts are int64 minor units (cents) with an ISO 4217 currency code. Never use floats for money.

contexts.title: API error format
contexts.body: HTTP APIs return RFC 9457 problem+json bodies with type, title, status and detail. No ad-hoc error shapes.

contexts.title: JWT in localStorage
contexts.body: Store JWT access tokens in localStorage and send them in the Authorization header.

contexts.title: Session cookies for auth
contexts.body: Browser authentication uses HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session cookies. Tokens are never kept in localStorage.

contexts.title: Frontend stack
contexts.body: Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind. Server components by default; client components only for interactivity.

contexts.title: Testing approach
contexts.body: Integration tests run against a real Postgres in Docker via testcontainers. No mocking the database.

contexts.title: Product search uses Meilisearch
contexts.body: Catalog search is served by Meilisearch, fed from the outbox. Postgres full-text was too slow for typo tolerance.

contexts.title: Timestamps in UTC
contexts.body: Store every timestamp as UTC timestamptz and convert to the user's zone only in the UI.

contexts.title: Background jobs on Sidekiq
contexts.body: Background jobs run on Sidekiq with Redis.

contexts.title: Background jobs
contexts.body: Background jobs use River, a Postgres-backed queue, so jobs commit atomically with the data they touch.

contexts.title: Flaky checkout test
contexts.body: TestCheckoutFlow fails intermittently on CI when the Stripe mock times out.

contexts.title: Slow image uploads
contexts.body: Image uploads to S3 were slow during the March load test.

contexts.title: Product images on S3 and CloudFront
contexts.body: Product images are uploaded directly to S3 with presigned URLs and served through CloudFront.

contexts.title: Translations
contexts.body: UI strings live in messages/{locale}.json and are loaded with next-intl. English is the source locale.

contexts.title: Deployments on Kubernetes
contexts.body: Services run on EKS. Each service ships a Helm chart, and Argo CD syncs them from the gitops repo.

contexts.title: Infrastructure as code
contexts.body: All cloud resources are managed with Terraform in the infra repo. No click-ops in the AWS console.

contexts.title: Secrets management
contexts.body: Application secrets live in AWS Secrets Manager and reach pods through External Secrets Operator. Never commit .env files.

contexts.title: Observability stack
contexts.body: Metrics in Prometheus, dashboards in Grafana, traces via OpenTelemetry to Tempo. Logs are JSON lines shipped to Loki.

contexts.title: On-call rotation
contexts.body: On-call rotates weekly on Mondays at 10:00 UTC through PagerDuty.

contexts.title: Primary AWS region
contexts.body: Production runs in eu-west-1; the disaster-recovery copy is in eu-central-1.

contexts.title: CI pipeline
contexts.body: GitHub Actions builds, tests and pushes images to ECR. Merges to main deploy to staging automatically.

contexts.title: Database backups
contexts.body: RDS snapshots are taken nightly and kept for 35 days. Point-in-time recovery is enabled.

contexts.title: Answer style
contexts.body: Keep answers short and direct. Lead with the recommendation, then the reasoning.

contexts.title: Preferred programming languages
contexts.body: Prefers Go for backend services and TypeScript for frontends. Avoids Java.

contexts.title: Editor setup
contexts.body: Uses Neovim with LazyVim at home and Cursor at work.

contexts.title: Japan trip
contexts.body: Planning a two-week trip to Japan in April, mostly Kyoto and Tokyo.

contexts.title: Diet
contexts.body: Vegetarian: no meat or fish in recipe suggestions.

contexts.title: Units
contexts.body: Use metric units and the 24-hour clock.
